## Design

### 2026-10-22 – October 21: #H9P3RN0VA!!!

**3.5h**

October 21: #H9P3RN0VA!!!

I prepared the .sym, .pretty, and 3D model files as usual, then it was time for the schematic design
(ofc # of hours count only to design).

The first thing I had to decide was choosing between the XIAO board or the Waveshare board. I chose Waveshare because I wanted to try something new.

Oh yeah, I customized my keyboard so that it has a solid 9 touchable keys:

![Screenshot 2026-10-21 171059](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/a4051b39ff81da1fbced5672ec351bcd82575055dc4efddd746bb925cb16f89e.png)

During the process, I've learned that Voltages are up and Grounds are down simply because it's easier to navigate when I'm doing the actual PCB design. Speaking of the PCB design, the GP's correlate with the touchable keys, so I'll probably connect them in the PCB design.

Looking at the keyboard switches, I made 9 different switches and noticed how they all connect to the same ground. But what is the significance of the Rotary Encoder? Is it supposed to control the parts?

![Screenshot 2026-10-21 173533](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/56f3b080a9894af29b5464deecfd1c7fe0a11def9289d3754522376dd129c0a8.png)

Now that's out of the way, I worked on the Bourns Slide Potantiometer, which seems to be a switch that can alternate, maybe the volume?, so instead of doing 2, I only did 1 because I only wanted to adjust the volume if the switch is going to be the volume. As for the Neopixels, I also did 3 if I wanted 3 colors of LED lights:

![Screenshot 2026-10-21 180846](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/14001702cdf8e5d7dea990b46e7a1ee1f58270db714a8ec50d650277d9b1acbf.png)

I was a bit curious, so I used the electrical rules checker to verify any errors, and I got a lot of them, however, most errors were intended and I don't really know why there are errors on connected components even though the components look connected:

![Screenshot 2026-10-21 181428](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/b4ce837e59e7c5da4708f039caf574cf1be9fc4f38d9c097331f9bded30b3979.png)

### 2026-10-23 – October 22: #H9P3RN0VA!!!

**2h**

October 22: #H9P3RN0VA!!!

I opened up the schematic editor and worked on assigning footprints
(luckily the footprint search bar made my life insufferable), and I ran into the fact that the kailh choc low footprint doesn't exist in my footprint library.

In order for a specific footprint to appear in a library search, I specifically added the .pretty file into the manage specific libraries, only then did the kailh choc low footprint showed up:

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 212024](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/c02b4458a5814cc882d6ade1d37268a30e2ec4fa75698f4021a06baa0cd0058c.png)

During the process, I also finally learned how to delete a footprint! (it's really that simple just choose a footprint right click on the footprint and poof! it disappears, I honestly don't know why I didn't know that before??? hello???)

Switching to the PCB design, I'm used to the fact that my design is different than the guide because I MADE it different and it also happened on the 5TARBIE:

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 214227](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/0a9f339abe7d950afae449d09d7268c0496c2e1de5e442f7a0eb82303e2981c9.png)
